communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: McGurk
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Presidential records of the Trump administration created or received by the National Security Council and other Executive Office of the President components between 1 January 2019 and 20 January 2021 relating to the Abraham Accords (the normalization agreements between Israel and the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Sudan, and Morocco) that reference Brett McGurk, including email messages and attachments, memoranda, briefing papers, talking points, meeting records, and attendee lists.
- Records of any communications between the National Security Council or other Executive Office of the President components and Brett McGurk, between 1 January 2019 and 20 January 2021.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
